passage.label: Ali 'Imran — Say O Allah Malik al-Mulk You give mulk to whom You will and take mulk from whom You will; honor and humble; in Your hand is khayr; over all things Qadeer; insert night into day and day into night; bring living from dead and dead from living; provide without measure; believers should not take disbelievers as awliya instead of believers; whoever does so has nothing with Allah unless guarding against them in precaution; Allah warns you of Himself; to Allah the destination; say whether conceal or reveal what is in breasts Allah knows; knows what is in heavens and earth; over all things Qadeer; Day every soul finds good present and wishes distance from evil; Allah warns of Himself; Allah Ra'uf bil-ibad; say if you love Allah follow me Allah will love you and forgive sins; Ghafoor Raheem; obey Allah and Messenger; if turn away Allah does not love kafirin; Allah chose Adam, Nuh, family of Ibrahim, family of Imran over worlds; descendants some from others; Samee' Aleem; when wife of Imran said My Lord I vowed what is in my womb consecrated accept from me; You are Samee' Aleem

arabicExcerpts.text: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ تُؤۡتِي ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلۡمُلۡكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلۡخَيۡرُۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ
تُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِۖ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡحَيَّ مِنَ ٱلۡمَيِّتِ وَتُخۡرِجُ ٱلۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلۡحَيِّۖ وَتَرۡزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ

لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَوۡلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَۖ وَمَن يَفۡعَلۡ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيۡسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِي شَيۡءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ تُقَىٰةٗۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسَهُۥۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
قُلۡ إِن تُخۡفُواْ مَا فِي صُدُورِكُمۡ أَوۡ تُبۡدُوهُ يَعۡلَمۡهُ ٱللَّهُۗ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٞ

يَوۡمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ مِنۡ خَيۡرٖ مُّحۡضَرٗا وَمَا عَمِلَتۡ مِن سُوٓءٖ تَوَدُّ لَوۡ أَنَّ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَهُۥٓ أَمَدَۢا بَعِيدٗاۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفۡسَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
قُلۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِي يُحۡبِبۡكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
قُلۡ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصۡطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحٗا وَءَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمۡرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ذُرِّيَّةَۢ بَعۡضُهَا مِنۢ بَعۡضٖۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
إِذۡ قَالَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتُ عِمۡرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرۡتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطۡنِي مُحَرَّرٗا فَتَقَبَّلۡ مِنِّيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ

mainSubject.label: Comprehensive divine sovereignty prayer (Malik al-Mulk): bestowal and removal of dominion, honor and humiliation, all good in divine hand, omnipotence; cosmic cycles (night/day alternation, life/death reversal) as manifestations of power; unlimited provision; prohibition of taking disbelievers as allies over believers with tactical exception for self-protection; divine self-warning; inner-state omniscience (concealed or revealed); eschatological presence of deeds and desire for distance from evil; divine kindness (Ra'uf); love-following reciprocity principle: loving Allah requires following the Prophet resulting in divine love and forgiveness; obedience command to Allah and Messenger; divine displeasure with disbelievers; election of Adam, Noah, Abraham's family, Imran's family above all worlds; generational continuity; wife of Imran's vow dedicating unborn child for sacred service; acceptance plea invoking Samee' Aleem
